Once upon a time:
, there was a big mountain. On top of the mountain, there was a small house. In the house, a boy named Tom lived with his mom and dad. They were a happy family.
One day, Tom went for a walk near the mountain. He saw a big tree with a lot of birds. He saw a squirrel and wanted to play with it. His mom told him, "Tom, be careful. Don't go too close to the edge of the mountain."
Tom did not listen to his mom. He climbed the tree and then he fell down. Tom was hurt and his leg was dead. He cried and cried. His mom came to help him. She said, "I told you to be careful, Tom."
The moral of the story is to listen to your parents. They want to keep you safe.
